listing.name: ED Shipyards
listing.summary: Provides refined collision models and specific hull adjustments for this mod.
listing.aiSummary: Provides refined collision models and specific hull adjustments for this mod.

description: Offers a patch containing updated .ship files for ED Shipyards. These files reduce points for performance, add precision to large civilian ships, modify the Basenji's hull, resize shields, and adjust radii including unique fixes for specific ships.
